instruction: Set the table with a cup and bowl

events.message: Observed cup and bowl in their independent arm workspaces

limitations: SO101 kinematics and inertias from MuJoCo Menagerie, not real hardware
Ground-truth object poses, not camera perception
Grasping uses weld constraints, not contact-based finger control
Arm mesh contacts disabled; gripper separation gate is not full-body collision checking
OpenVINO executes a geometric graph, not a trained VLA policy
Simulation results do not certify physical robot safety
